evidence.source: Agenția Națională pentru Ocuparea Forței de Muncă – Raport formare profesională iulie 2026 / comunicat 20 august 2026

measures.name: persons_in_ANOFM_training_or_competence_evaluation_Jan_Jul_2026
measures.denominator_universe: participants included by ANOFM in vocational training programmes and competence-evaluation processes in January-July 2026

limitations: national aggregate, not a NUTS2 three-region estimate
does not identify AI-specific or digital-skill deficits
does not measure the project's eligible >29 target group directly
evidence.use: Fresh official 2026 context confirming material adult-training activity through the public employment service. It supports feasibility/context only and cannot close the direct target-group need gap.

evidence.source: AJOFM Ialomița – Cursuri de formare profesională organizate în anul 2026

facts.course_scope: competență digitală, inclusiv siguranță pe internet și securitate cibernetică
facts.access_rule_reported: free for registered unemployed persons in AJOFM Ialomița records

limitations: course provision is not empirical proof of prevalence or severity of a digital-skill deficit
one county does not represent the whole Sud-Muntenia region
the offer does not establish AI-specific employer demand
evidence.use: Current local institutional signal that digital upskilling is an active employment-service response in Sud-Muntenia; contextual only.
